### 2. Full-Stack Engineering Intern — NeuraMach AI Studios
- **Duration**: January 12, 2026 – April 11, 2026
- **Location**: Pune, India
- **Technologies Used**: Node.js, AWS API Gateway, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, SES, S3, CloudFront, Next.js, CI/CD.
- **Key Technical Achievements**:
  - Re-architected backend infrastructure from AppSync to API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, and SES, eliminating public data exposure and improving API security.
  - Built REST endpoints and Lambda handlers in Node.js with strict validation schemas and DynamoDB persistence.
  - Implemented abuse-resistant submission pipeline with multi-window rate limiting (IP/email), input validation, and injection protection.
  - Architected secure HLS video delivery using AWS S3 + CloudFront with signed cookies and role-based access control.
  - Resolved 15+ cross-layer production issues across Next.js, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS services, reducing overall deployment failures by 40%.

### 3. Freelance Full-Stack Project — Abhinandan Mountreea

### 4. Research Developer (BCI NeuroArm) — IS360 Technologies
- **Duration**: July 2024 – December 2024
- **Location**: Pune, India
- **Technologies Used**: Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, EEG Signal Processing.
- **Key Technical Achievements**:
  - Developed a Neuro Signal Classifier for the BCI NeuroArm prosthetic control project.
  - Engineered an end-to-end EEG signal processing pipeline to acquire, clean, preprocess, and classify brain signal data to predict movement intent (left arm vs right arm movement).
  - Designed and trained ML classification models achieving high accuracy in intent prediction.
  - Created real-time visualization components mapping classified neural signals into motor outputs.

## Detailed Project Catalog

### Project 1: NeuroArm Signal Flow
- **Description**: Interactive web visualization of an EEG signal processing pipeline for prosthetic arm control.
- **Technical Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, D3.js, Chart.js.
- **Live Demo**: https://neuro-arm.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/NeuroArm
- **Key Features**: Visualizes raw EEG signal acquisition, filter stages, spectral analysis, ML feature extraction, classification output, and arm motor commands in real time.

### Project 2: Animated Website Design
- **Description**: Motion-led modern web application demonstrating fluid scroll timing, layered canvas motion, and responsive layout composition.
- **Technical Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), JavaScript.
- **Live Demo**: https://animated-design-website.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Code**: https://github.com/pshah-lab/animated-design-website
- **Key Features**: Micro-interactions, scroll-driven timelines, dark/light theme integration, high frame-rate animations.

### Project 3: Abhinandan Mountreea
- **Description**: Commercial real estate portfolio website showcasing residential projects and luxury villas.
- **Technical Stack**: React, TypeScript, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Next.js.
- **Live Demo**: https://www.abhinandanmountreea.com/
- **Key Features**: High-definition image galleries, property layout showcases, contact inquiry forms, and cross-device performance optimization.
